title: Verify your connection to AIS
description: Tell us how you are connected to Aichi International School. A committee member reviews every application, usually within a few days.
resubmitDescription: Please update your application and send it again.

needsInfo.title: The committee needs a little more information:

hints.nameRomaji: In Latin letters, e.g. Yamada / Taro.
hints.nameKanji: In kanji or kana, e.g. 山田 / 太郎 or やまだ / たろう.
hints.nameAtAis: If different from your current name (e.g. maiden name or nickname).
hints.dateOfBirth: Used only for verification and age-appropriate privacy. Never shown to other members.
hints.locale: Used for emails and LINE messages.
hints.schoolEmail: If you have an AIS email address, we can send it a code to confirm your role faster.
hints.parentConfirmation: Student accounts must also be confirmed by a parent or guardian with an AIS Alumni account, or by the committee.
hints.classmates: We may ask these members to confirm that they know you. Please give 1–2 names.
hints.cohort: Classes are numbered by the year they finished 6th grade (2016 = 第5期). Choose the class you belong to, even if you joined or left AIS in a different year.
